raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (362 rows, all tagged source_tz='UTC') stores txn_ts in UTC, while the other 13 batches are America/Chicago local time. The pipeline treats every txn_ts as local, so the UTC rows land 5-6 hours early. That pushes about 104 transactions into 2026-01-19 00:00-06:00, outside merchant hours. Converting UTC rows to America/Chicago local time, matching the other batches, should fix the dates and hours.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
